# Retro handheld

Every app in this list that runs on Retro handheld. That is 10 apps with 3 for Plex and 7 for Jellyfin and 1 for Emby. Apps for more than one server count once per server. The legend is in [README.md](../README.md#legend) and every other platform is in [PLATFORMS.md](../PLATFORMS.md).

> **Want these apps to play straight from debrid or Usenet?** [rex](https://rex.debridmediamanager.com/) and [zurg](https://zurg.debridmediamanager.com/) are made by the team that keeps this list. [See what they do.](../README.md#from-the-maintainers)

## Video and general

- [emby-tui](https://github.com/booYah187/emby-tui) - Terminal client that also runs on Android and muOS and JELOS handhelds. `Jellyfin` `Emby` · `Retro handheld` `CLI` · `GPL-3.0` `Stale 2025`
- [jellyfin-rg35xxh](https://github.com/aG00Dtime/jellyfin-rg35xxh) - Controller-first app for the Anbernic RG35XX H. `Jellyfin` · `Retro handheld` · `MIT` `Free`
- [Minifin](https://github.com/zakijss/MiniFin) - Movies and shows on the Miyoo Mini Plus. `Jellyfin` · `Retro handheld` · `MIT` `Free`
- [Miyoofin](https://github.com/S3ggie/MiyooFin) - App for the Miyoo Mini Plus running Onion OS. `Jellyfin` · `Retro handheld` · `GPL-3.0` `Free`
- [Mufin](https://github.com/escal8tor/MuFin) - App for handhelds running muOS. `Jellyfin` · `Retro handheld` · `AGPL-3.0` `Free`
- [onion-os-jellyfin-clients](https://github.com/TownsendBrown/onion-os-jellyfin-clients) - Onion OS app for streaming video on Miyoo-class handhelds. `Jellyfin` · `Retro handheld` · `MIT` `Free`
- [PocketFlex](https://github.com/jackharvest/PocketFlex) - Client for the Miyoo Mini Plus retro handheld. `Plex` · `Retro handheld` · `MIT`
- [pocketplex](https://github.com/sleepdebt/pocketplex) - Text-first Plex client for Linux retro handhelds. `Plex` · `Retro handheld` · `Open source`

## Music

- [muSE Player](https://github.com/Cappyjune4/muse-player-rg35xxh) - Anbernic RG35XXH player for radio, podcasts and server music. `Jellyfin` · `Retro handheld` · `Open source` `Free`
- [PlexMusic.pak](https://github.com/thwonp/PlexMusicPak) - Plex music player pak for TrimUI Brick and other MinUI handhelds. `Plex` · `Retro handheld` · `Open source`
